baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic photographic still inside a near-future community robotics studio at dusk, as a successful repair session turns into an awkwardly affectionate invitation to watch a meteor shower. The cast consists of four fictional adults: one man seated on the front edge of a sturdy workbench and three women gathered close to him. The attached portrait serves as an appearance reference for the bob-haired woman on the left: a short straight dark bob with fine parted wispy fringe, brown eyes, a softly tapered face, small nose and natural rosy lips. This is a separately authored fictional character. Several people direct romantic interest toward the same person, one shared recipient of competing affection. The bob-haired woman in a soft rust cardigan offers the man a palm-sized robot with a glowing heart-shaped chest panel; her hands support its base while his right palm has just slid underneath to accept it. She looks directly into his face with an intimate, conspiratorial smile, her shoulders turned toward him. The woman to his right, in a sage utility shirt with her long hair loosely tied back, gently links her right arm through his relaxed left elbow, resting her fingertips on his forearm and leaning close enough to seek his attention, her warm gaze fixed on him. Behind the bench corner, a third woman with a swept-back copper bob holds two steaming mugs close together; she watches the same man with a hopeful smile that turns rueful as she notices the linked arm. The man wears a rumpled pale work shirt and pauses with a surprised, pleased smile, his eyes meeting the gift-giver while his relaxed linked arm acknowledges the woman beside him. Their competing gestures make the recipient pause between them. The women register each other's approaches through small sideways glances, giving the tenderness a trace of friendly rivalry. Open tools, a recently repaired small telescope robot and a rolled rooftop observation mat make the end of shared work and the next invitation readable. A compact articulated service robot is quietly parking itself at a charging pad in the background; through the tall roof window, the first pale meteor crosses a deepening blue sky. Frame from just above the knees upward at conversational eye level, keeping all four faces, the two-person gift handover and linked elbow clearly visible together. Leave space between the small robot, the man's chest and the two women's arms, with each hand connected to its own forearm. Warm work-lamp light shapes the faces against cool skylight; natural skin, worn fabric and modest workshop clutter carry a believable near-future romantic comedy moment.
